cannotTest: A reviewer must judge: whether a library component exists for a given need and was used in preference to other third-party or custom components (e.g. dropdown menus vs overflow-menu, side navigation vs zest-sidekick-menu, page layout vs zest-responsive-layout, file uploads via <input type=file> vs zest-file-upload, and polling done through fetch loops or setTimeout instead of jattac-web-poller). Also that the packages are installed (they are currently listed in front-end/package.json, except jattac.libs.web.zest-file-upload, which is missing).
